drills.instruction: Nghe đoạn rồi chọn đáp án đúng.

items.question: What does the speaker say the company sells?
items.transcript:
W-Am: As the company president, I'm excited to share that we've sold a record number of home appliances for two years in a row, and I'd like to reward your hard work. First, everyone will be eligible for a one-time monetary bonus. Your supervisor will speak with you about how it'll be calculated and when you'll receive it. Also, I'd like to offer more flexibility in your schedule, so all employees will be permitted to work remotely twice a week. You'll just need to note those days on your calendar, so everyone knows where you are.
80. What does the speaker say the company sells?
81. What will the listeners discuss with their supervisors?
82. How will the company offer more flexibility?
items.explanation: Người nói tự hào thông báo rằng "we've sold a record number of home appliances..." (chúng ta đã bán được số lượng đồ gia dụng kỷ lục...).
items.label: place_business

Thanks for coming in early this morning. I wanted to update you on the caf refrigerators that our customers use. We recently installed a new temperature monitoring system. I've noticed that every increase in temperature can be traced to the refrigerator doors being left open for extended periods of time. This is alarming because it compromises the freshness and safety of our food. We all know that customers often take a while to make their selection. I'll be meeting with the management team to discuss ways to address this.
92. Where does the speaker most likely work?
93. What is the speaker concerned about?

items.question: Who are the listeners?

I'd like to thank you all for attending Omnicom Department Store's staff meeting. As you'll recall, six months ago we made a deal with Euphoria sports clothing to sell their merchandise exclusively in our department stores. The hope is that we can attract new customers to our stores by selling this brand. Data show that foot traffic in the department stores containing Euphoria clothing is up twenty percent from last year. Keep in mind, however, that total sales revenues are still being calculated.
92. Who are the listeners?

items.question: What industry does the speaker work in?

W-Br: Hi, Mr. Flores. This is Susana, the supervisor of the construction crew working on your renovation project. I'm calling because we've run into an issue with the front window replacements. Your house was built a long time ago and has settled over the years. Unfortunately, this has caused some frame alignment issues. We will not be able to install the new bay window you requested for the front room without more extensive work than the budget will cover. Our work is done for today, but we'll need to know how to proceed by tomorrow. I'll be available for the next couple of hours.
83. What industry does the speaker work in?
84. According to the speaker, what has caused a problem?
85. Why does the speaker say, "I'll be available for the next couple of hours"?
items.explanation: Người nói giới thiệu mình là "the supervisor of the construction crew" (người giám sát của đội thi công/xây dựng).
items.label: place_business
items.labelVi: Nơi chốn / loại hình công ty

items.question: Who is Mona Alamri?
items.transcript:
Regular listeners of the Going Electric podcast may be familiar with today's guest because she was on the podcast last year. Dr. Mona Alamri is a leading transportation engineer. In today's episode, she'll be talking about electric ships that can operate with zero emissions. These high-speed ships may completely change the way people and goods are moved along the world's coastlines. But, before I welcome Dr. Alamri, please note there is a change to next month's schedule-most notably, I'll be on vacation for three weeks.
92. Who is Mona Alamri?
93. What is the focus of today's podcast episode?
94. What does the speaker alert the listeners to?
items.explanation: Khách mời được giới thiệu: 'Dr. Mona Alamri is a leading transportation engineer.' (Tiến sĩ Mona Alamri là một kỹ sư giao thông hàng đầu). Cô ấy là kỹ sư (An engineer).
items.label: identity

Since you're auditioning to join the cast of an ongoing show, you should watch some videos of previous episodes so you understand the role. One last note-since you're new to the city, you might be wondering about the best bus route to take. You could take the green line to Orchard, but I'd recommend taking the yellow line to the last stop. It's a longer route, but the last stop is closer to the studio.

100. Look at the graphic. Which bus stop does the speaker recommend getting off at?

All of ours are at least ten years old. If you're interested in more details, e-mail our media relations department to receive a summary of the findings.

items.context: Actually, I just finished testing the game this morning. I found a problem in the third stage of the game. There were a few times when my ______ couldn't move.
items.transcript:
W: Hi, Koji. I think our new video game is nearly ready to be released. Are you aware of any improvements that need to be made before then?
M: Actually, I just finished testing the game this morning. I found a problem in the third stage of the game. There were a few times when my character couldn't move.
W: Oh, that's strange!
